summary: OpenAI launched a program providing free access to its frontier models, including GPT-5.6, to researchers, starting with 10,000 and scaling to 100,000 by 2027.

mechanisms.reason: A stated expansion of free frontier-model access to up to 100,000 researchers increases aggregate usage of the models.
mechanisms.quote: starting with 10,000 researchers and expanding to 100,000 through 2027
